title: A Lie Correspondence in the Setting of Hopf and Frobenius Algebras
summary: In this paper we demonstrate that Hopf algebras and Frobenius algebras provide an appropriate setting for an analogue of the classical Lie correspondence. We introduce a compatibility structure between Hopf and Frobenius algebras called Hopf-Frobenius modules, and give constructions that can be applied to any such module, which produce corresponding Lie groups and Lie algebras.
